plain_english: O Goddess, having cut through to the supreme state, he leads one there; therefore he is called the guru.
sanskrit_cite: chittvā paraṃ padaṃ devi nayatyenamato guruḥ

plain_english: Having assumed the form of the teacher, he liberates bound souls through initiation.
sanskrit_cite: ācāryarūpamāsthāya dīkṣayā mokṣayet paśūn

plain_english: Thus god, mantra, and guru are said to have one and the same meaning.
sanskrit_cite: tathā devaśca mantraśca guruścaikārtha ucyate

plain_english: The fruit obtained by worshipping god, mantra, and guru is equal.
sanskrit_cite: devamantragurūṇāñca pūjayā sadṛśaṃ phalam

plain_english: Having assumed the form of the guru, he acts to cut the bonds of worldly existence.
sanskrit_cite: gururūpaṃ samādāya bhavapāśānnikṛntaye

plain_english: One who is unbroken and always joyful in heart is called a guru.
sanskrit_cite: avicchinnaḥ sadā hṛṣṭahṛdayo gururucyate

plain_english: O beloved, that luminous yogi who is beyond caste and stage of life is declared to be the guru.
sanskrit_cite: jyotivarṇāśramī yogī sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, he who knows according to proper method is declared to be the guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo jānāti vidhānena sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, he whose breath becomes steady without effort is the guru.
sanskrit_cite: vināyāsaṃ sthiro vāyuryasya syāt sa guruḥ priye

plain_english: O lady of the Kula, he by whom that truth is known is the guru.
sanskrit_cite: tattattvaṃ viditaṃ yena sa guruḥ kulanāyike

plain_english: O Goddess, he indeed is the guru who is the piercer, knowing the sixfold piercing.
sanskrit_cite: vedhañca ṣaḍvidhaṃ devi sa hi vedhakaro guruḥ

plain_english: O beloved, he who purifies the six paths is declared to be the guru.
sanskrit_cite: śodhayed yaḥ ṣaḍadhvānaṃ sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, whoever properly knows is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, whoever knows the pentad is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo vetti pañcakaṃ devi sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, whoever properly knows is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, whoever knows the tetrad is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: catuṣṭayaṃ vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O supreme goddess, O beloved, whoever knows is the guru, and no other.
sanskrit_cite: yo vetti parameśāni sa gururnāparaḥ priye

plain_english: Whoever knows the threefold is considered the supreme guru.
sanskrit_cite: trividhaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ

plain_english: O fair one, O beloved, whoever knows is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo jānāti varārohe sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, whoever knows the triad is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: tritayaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: O beloved, whoever knows in truth is declared to be a guru.
sanskrit_cite: tattvato yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priye

plain_english: Whoever is able to purify is considered the supreme guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo viśodhayituṃ śaktaḥ sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ

plain_english: O great goddess, whoever knows is considered the supreme guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo jānāti mahādevi sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ

plain_english: And whoever knows the root lock is considered the supreme guru.
sanskrit_cite: mūlabandhañca yo vetti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ

plain_english: Whoever knows in essence is held to be the supreme guru.
sanskrit_cite: yo vijānāti tattvena sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ
